description: Continue an existing shell session and return newly collected output plus process status. Use action "wait" for observation and optional input: omit chars and eof for a read-only wait; provide chars and/or eof to deliver input before observing. When action is omitted and the request contains no input fields, the host infers action "wait". chars works for pipe and PTY sessions. eof closes stdin for pipe sessions and returns eof_not_supported for PTY sessions. The wait budget is yield_time_ms: read-only waits default to 10000 ms and allow 10000-300000; waits that write input default to 500 ms and allow 500-60000. Use action "stop" to request process-tree cancellation. Already-finished sessions return immediately. An observation expiry leaves a running process alive. wall_time_seconds is this call's elapsed time, not cumulative process lifetime. Model-facing text shows at most the last 2000 lines or 50 KiB; truncated output is saved to a file. Programmatic callers receive independently bounded structured output, including status and exit_code when terminal. Later calls return only new output.

action.description: Observe this session and optionally deliver chars or eof before observing. Omit chars and eof for a read-only wait.

session_id.description: Short opaque session_id returned by bash in this agent run. Pass it unchanged to shell_control; never use an OS PID.

chars.description: Empty or omitted chars means no input.

eof.description: No stdin is closed during a read-only wait.

yield_time_ms.description: Observation budget in integer milliseconds. Read-only waits use 10000-300000; waits that write chars or EOF use 500-60000. Default 10000 for a read-only wait.

session_id.description: Short opaque session_id returned by bash in this agent run. Pass it unchanged to shell_control; never use an OS PID.

chars.description: Optional exact UTF-8 text sent to the session, at most 65536 bytes. No trimming or appended newline. Include \n when required. PTY sessions receive this as terminal input.

eof.description: Pipe sessions only. After optional chars, permanently close the pipe stdin. PTY sessions reject eof with error code eof_not_supported. EOF is not process termination or Ctrl+C.

yield_time_ms.description: Observation budget in integer milliseconds. Read-only waits use 10000-300000; waits that write chars or EOF use 500-60000. Default 500 after input.
